Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men ghurdaur dekhne ke dauran begusray ke arvind sinh ki tabiyat bigarne se maut ho gaee thi. ab anant sinh ke donon bete (Anant Singh Son) unke ghar pahunche aur parijnon ko har sanbhav madad ka bharosa diya. mritak ke bete ne kisi se shikayat nahin bataee.
